extension.description: Use your local Magpie AI gateway from a Remote-SSH workspace with secure tunneling and remote agent launchers.
command.connect: Magpie: Connect Local Gateway to Remote
command.changeHost: Magpie: Change SSH Host for This Workspace
setting.sshHost: Suggested SSH alias or user@host:port for the first connection. A saved workspace mapping takes priority.
setting.gatewayPort: Port of the local Magpie gateway on 127.0.0.1.
setting.remotePort: Bridge port on remote 127.0.0.1. Use different ports for simultaneous windows on the same server.
setting.sshPath: Local OpenSSH executable name or absolute path. Supports ~/.
setting.sshConfigFile: Optional absolute local SSH config path. Supports ~/. Use the same file as Remote-SSH if customized.
setting.model: Model ID for new agent sessions. Leave empty to use the local Magpie model defaults for Claude Code.
setting.autoConnect: Connect automatically in trusted SSH workspaces with a previously saved SSH target.
setting.autoReconnect: Retry an unexpected disconnect up to three times, preserving the session token and terminals.
setup.title: Connect Magpie to Your Remote Workspace
setup.description: Keep provider accounts on your computer while coding agents work remotely.
setup.gateway.title: Start the local Magpie gateway
setup.gateway.description:
Open Magpie on your computer and enable its gateway. The default address is http://127.0.0.1:3425.
[Check Gateway](command:magpieBridge.diagnose)
[Bridge Settings](command:magpieBridge.settings)
setup.connect.title: Open a Remote-SSH folder and connect
setup.connect.description:
Open your remote project with Remote-SSH. Choose the same SSH server and user. The bridge verifies remote HTTP access before marking the connection ready.
[Connect](command:magpieBridge.connect)
setup.agent.title: Start your remote coding agent
setup.agent.description:
The bridge checks the remote CLI before launch, including user bin directories and interactive shell PATH. If missing, open a configured remote terminal or the official installation guide. Codex offers a native Linux ARM64 binary without npm.
[Start Claude Code](command:magpieBridge.claude)
[Start Codex CLI](command:magpieBridge.codex)
[Codex installation](https://github.com/openai/codex)
[Claude Code installation](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/setup)
